title: Security Composer demo: the file store's image can no longer be downloaded. Pin it, and keep a copy off the demo machine?
bluf: Tap a, b or c. Nothing has been changed on the demo. A read-only check today (B287, read through Azure run-command) found the demo's file store runs from the only known copy of its image, kept on the demo machine. quay.io now refuses to hand that image out without a login, both by name and by exact fingerprint (pull refused from this Mac, B287 runs/R1-B-2-pull-latest.txt). A normal deploy still works, because it only downloads what is missing. A machine rebuild, a clean-up of unused images, or a new machine could not get it back. That the demo machine's own network is refused the same way is unmeasured.

options.label: Pin the image in the demo's settings file only
options.detail: One line, backed up first, no restart, one-line rollback (B287 proposed/apply-and-rollback.md). It stops the name drifting; it does not bring back a lost image.

options.label: Pin it AND keep a copy of the image off the demo machine
options.detail: As a, plus a seat saves the exact image (about 241 MB, the demo has 47 GB free) and keeps the copy on G-DRIVE, so a rebuild can be restored. The transfer route off the machine is unmeasured; the seat measures it first and stops if it needs anything new.

options.label: Hold until the next planned demo deploy
options.detail: Nothing changes now. The risk stays as described.

default_action: Option c: nothing on the demo changes. Tuesday folds the pin into the next demo deploy card.
